verse.name: v1
v3
verse.lines:
Biweddewo kaakano
Bigambo bya leero;
-Omulokozi,tuwonye
Mu maayi g'ekibi.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Tukuume-emyoyo gyaffe;
Katonda ggwe-omanyi,
Obubi bw'omu kkubo
Ffe lye tuyitamu.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Mu budde obw'enzikiza,
Ayi Yesu otukuumenga.
